ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.description: This card increases in power for each turn in your [gold]Hand[/gold], and resets when you play it. Past its peak, it transforms into [gold]Toxic[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-FERMENT.title: Ferment
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.description: [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card until the end of combat. Attacks gain [blue]2[/blue] [purple]Laced[/purple]; Skills gain [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Fuming[/purple]; Powers gain [blue]1[/blue] [purple]Exalted[/purple]. Other cards gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.selectionPromptAny: Choose any number of cards to [gold]Infuse[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-INFUSE.title: Infuse
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description: A card with [gold]Reaction[/gold] gains an extra effect if you play it directly after a matching card in the same turn.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.attack: If you play this card directly after an Attack in the same turn, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.block: If you play this card directly after a card that gained [gold]Block[/gold] in the same turn, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.enchanted: If you play this card directly after an [gold]Enchanted[/gold] card in the same turn, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.exhaust: If any card was [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this turn, this card has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.power: If you play this card directly after a Power in the same turn, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.description.skill: If you play this card directly after a Skill in the same turn, it has a [gold]Reaction[/gold] effect.
ALCHEMIST-REACTION.title: Reaction
